top_paper.title: Intrinsic Distribution Matching
top_paper.summary: Intrinsic Distribution Matching improves few-step text-to-image generation by adding explicit moment constraints to distribution matching distillation, achieving state-of-the-art long-text rendering with minimal network evaluations.

papers.title: EPSBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Earnings Forecasting
papers.summary: The study introduces EPSBench to evaluate AI agents in forecasting quarterly earnings by linking financial evidence to income-statement drivers and comparing model predictions to analyst consensus.

papers.title: Weaken to Strengthen: Weakening-Induced On-Policy Self-Distillation for Large Reasoning Models
papers.summary: WISD improves reasoning models by contrasting them with weaker quantized or pruned versions to generate training signals without privileged data.

papers.title: Unlocking Any-Order Generation in Pretrained Autoregressive Image Models
papers.summary: Pretrained raster-scan autoregressive image models can be adapted into flexible any-order generators via future-aware positional embeddings and an ordering curriculum, enabling inpainting and outpainting with minimal extra compute.

papers.title: Matched Capabilities, Different Behaviors: A Controlled Study of MCP and CLI Interfaces for Language Agents
papers.summary: Matched interface representations significantly alter agent behavior despite identical executable capabilities, and targeted repair of interface-specific realization improves performance while reducing cost.

papers.title: Broken on Arrival: Non-Functional Quantized LLM Artifacts in Public Model Registries and How to Catch Them
papers.summary: Quantized small language model files in public registries can be non-functional due to uncalibrated quantization recipes, and screening plus calibration is recommended before release.

papers.title: Training Foundation Models with a Single Algorithm
papers.summary: Foundation-model training stages can be unified under a single likelihood-based algorithm that blends static data and reinforcement learning generations, improving efficiency and capability retention.

papers.title: ABF-Bench: A Verifiable Benchmark for Agentic Blockchain Forensics
papers.summary: ABF-Bench introduces an interactive, evidence-backed benchmark for blockchain fund tracing that evaluates adaptive agents against fixed tracers, revealing gaps in recall and overconfidence while enabling verifiable LLM agent training.

papers.title: Proving and Improving the Platonic Representation Hypothesis with JEPAs
papers.summary: Joint-embedding predictive architectures trained on aligned multi-modal observations converge to shared representations with far greater efficiency than next-token prediction, demonstrating that positive view design—not scale alone—drives cross-modal alignment.

papers.title: Scaling Lean Theorem Proving for Real-World Code Verification
papers.summary: EasyProver is a Lean proving system using recursive agents and asynchronous search that solves nearly all Putnam and IMO benchmark problems, while Aegis generates harder verification tasks from competitive programming to benchmark provers and support reinforcement learning.

papers.title: FDSML: Formula-Driven Supervised Metric Learning with Parameter-Aware Triplet Loss
papers.summary: Formula-driven supervised metric learning uses continuous generative parameters to train embeddings with parameter-aware triplet loss, improving synthetic pre-training for image retrieval and robustness.

papers.title: Holo4D: Holistic 4D Reconstruction as Geometric Control for Video Diffusion
papers.summary: Holo4D guides video diffusion with reconstructed 3D trajectory scaffolds to synthesize novel-view videos while preserving geometry and motion.

papers.title: Youtu-Parsing-Omni: One Encoder, One Schema, All Modalities
papers.summary: Youtu-Parsing-Omni is a unified multi-modal parser that encodes documents, images, audio, and video into structured spatiotemporal records using shared weights and cross-modal fusion, achieving state-of-the-art results across parsing benchmarks through a self-evolving on-policy distillation procedure.

papers.title: OpenFlyV2: An onboard vision-language-action model for aerial perception and navigation
papers.summary: OpenFlyV2 is a unified onboard vision-language-action model that enables real-time aerial navigation and reasoning on resource-constrained hardware using shared multimodal representations.

papers.title: PhysInsert: Physically Plausible Object Insertion with Geometric Priors and Bidirectional Object-Scene Interactions
papers.summary: PhysInsert enables physically plausible object insertion by jointly adapting objects and scenes using geometry-guided adaptation and spatial supervision on aligned counterfactual data.

papers.title: AB-Attention: Accurate Block Attention for Accelerating Video Diffusion Transformers
papers.summary: AB-Attention approximates dense video diffusion attention with high sparsity via intra-block clustering, weighted sampling, and fine-grained kernel gathering, improving fidelity and speed.

papers.title: Multi-Token Prediction Done Right
papers.summary: Soft-MTP removes a noisy gradient residual from multi-token prediction via a straight-through KL recovery trick, improving perplexity, speculative decoding, and reasoning without added cost.

papers.title: Read, Allocate, Route: Role-Coupled Tokenization for Pixel-Space Generative Transformers
papers.summary: SpecSlot improves pixel-space generative Transformers by using localized spectral slots and restricted global attention to increase image detail without raising computational cost.

papers.title: L3G-World: Real-Time Infinite World Generation with Latent 3D Gaussian Memory
papers.summary: L3G-World uses a compact latent 3D Gaussian memory and alternating autoregressive updates with a video diffusion transformer to generate spatially consistent interactive worlds in real time.

papers.title: Investor's Last Exam: Can AI Agents Do Equity Investment Without Seeing the Future?
papers.summary: Investor's Last Exam evaluates financial agents on end-to-end equity research using frozen evidence, expert criteria, and dependency graphs, revealing that top models excel at research but fail at forecasting and investment judgments.

papers.title: Online Dense Reinforcement Learning with Planning-Grounding Agent for UI Navigation on Live IOS Apps
papers.summary: An online reinforcement learning framework trains UI navigation agents on live mobile apps using a planning agent, UI grounding model, and a novel neighbor-conditioned value estimation method to improve robustness and reduce inference costs.

papers.title: Glance: The Generator Is Its Own Reranker
papers.summary: Glance integrates reranking and generation into a single backbone using lightweight adapters and pointer heads to score passages from shared context, reducing memory overhead while improving retrieval and answer quality.

papers.title: A-RSI: Adaptive Task Refresh for Zero-Data Multimodal Self-Improvement
papers.summary: A-RSI improves recursive self-improvement by refreshing training tasks based on declining learning signals and using independently verifiable program-generated answers, raising benchmark performance without external labels.

papers.title: Look Only When Needed: Certificate-Guided Visual Routing for Efficient Diffusion VLMs
papers.summary: LOWN adaptively skips image processing during diffusion vision-language model decoding when predictions agree, reducing computation while preserving accuracy.

papers.title: CoSTA: Compressed Speech Token Adaptation for Efficient Spoken Dialogue Models
papers.summary: CoSTA decouples generation and synthesis token spaces to accelerate spoken dialogue models while preserving quality and compatibility.

papers.title: Your LR Schedule May Not Be Principled: Effective Learning Rate Scheduling in Weight-Normalized Training
papers.summary: Effective learning rate trajectories primarily drive weight-normalized training gains, motivating an affine inverse-square-root schedule that improves large-scale pretraining loss and robustness.

papers.title: HairDeck: Animation-Ready Stylized Hair Cards from a Single Image
papers.summary: HairDeck generates stylized hair cards and spring-bone animations as unordered token sets using a diffusion transformer, improving accuracy and speed over prior methods.

papers.title: SO-101 Bench: Accessible Spatial Manipulation
papers.summary: A simulated benchmark for language-conditioned spatial manipulation on low-cost robot arms reveals that hybrid LLM agents outperform learned vision-language-action policies, with ranking consistency between simulation and real hardware.

papers.title: Intrinsic Distribution Matching
papers.summary: Intrinsic Distribution Matching improves few-step text-to-image generation by adding explicit moment constraints to distribution matching distillation, achieving state-of-the-art long-text rendering with minimal network evaluations.

papers.title: Your Benchmark Is an Empirical Measure Over Difficulty
papers.summary: This work formalizes benchmark evaluation through difficulty measures, identifies failure modes of measure mismatch and coverage gaps, and proposes diagnostic metrics and a rewriting algorithm to improve benchmark coverage.

papers.title: A Broader Look into MLLM's Retrieval Heads
papers.summary: Retrieval heads remain sparse and shared across audio-visual modalities, and optimizing them improves document retrieval performance in multimodal models.
